newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FCL Mangahewa-2 tests to start Friday.
newsitem.headline: FCL Mangahewa-2 tests to start Friday.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Energy Division said on Thursday it had mobilised well test equipment on its Mangahewa-2 onshore Taranaki site and planned to start short-term testing on Friday to establish flow rates.
FCL is looking to determine the size and produceability of the Mangahewa-2 gas resource.

It said that at the Piakau-1 re-entry and sidetrack, the unavailability of nitrogen has delayed any testing until next week. Meanwhile the Kaimiro 15 well spudded on March 4 with current depth at 310 metres.
